messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] New rhipe installation - guava problem
parts:
Not sure, but i wouldn't bother running Rhipe. it wont work with CDH4.
There are plans to upgade soon, but not in the near future (near == 1 month).



On Thu, Feb 7, 2013 at 3:24 PM, <jose...@gene.com> wrote:
We have a new Rhipe installation on a cluster running CDH 4.1.2.
Using JDK version 1.6.0_31, R version 2.15.2, protobuf version 2.4.1, guava version 14.0-rc2. 
OS is CentOS 6.2.

Upon invocation we get a missing class error for com.google.common.cache.CacheBuilder. Stacktrace is:

> rhinit()
Rhipe initialization complete
Rhipe first run complete
Initializing mapfile caches
java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: com.google.common.cache.CacheBuilder.recordStats()Lcom/google/common/cache/CacheBuilder;
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.initializeCaches(PersonalServer.java:427)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:39)
at sun.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:25)
at java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:597)
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.startme(PersonalServer.java:720)
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.run(PersonalServer.java:760)
at org.apache.hadoop.util.ToolRunner.run(ToolRunner.java:70)
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.main(PersonalServer.java:772)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:39)
at sun.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:25)
at java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:597)
at org.apache.hadoop.util.RunJar.main(RunJar.java:208)

Error in Rhipe:::send.cmd(rhoptions()$child$handle, list("initializeCaches",  : 
  Error response from Rhipe Java server.

After seeing this, I installed guava-14.0-rc2.jar and pushed it onto CLASSPATH. However the error persists. 
I confirmed a hit for recordStats in CacheBuilder.class, included in the jarfile.

Any suggestions?

--

Thanks. We (rhipe developers) will begin to reboot the documentation. Starting with
1. installation on EC2 (easily replicable)
2.installation on a private cluster where the home folder is shared across the nodes (and typically requires a runner script)
3. installation on a cluster where R is not present on the nodes (personal experience).

The last one  should ideally work in the case of the first two. Ideally we shall test the EC2 approach on ubuntu and centos6.

Regards
Saptarshi
On Tue, Mar 12, 2013 at 8:57 AM, <jose...@gene.com> wrote:

Just to close the circle for any lurkers out there :) there is good news to report. 

With Saptarshi's assistance I have Rhipe running now on CDH4.

There are a few lingering relatively minor issues which I will post separately about.

On Friday, February 8, 2013 12:24:20 AM UTC+1, jose...@gene.com wrote:
We have a new Rhipe installation on a cluster running CDH 4.1.2.
Using JDK version 1.6.0_31, R version 2.15.2, protobuf version 2.4.1, guava version 14.0-rc2. 
OS is CentOS 6.2.

Upon invocation we get a missing class error for com.google.common.cache.CacheBuilder. Stacktrace is:

> rhinit()
Rhipe initialization complete
Rhipe first run complete
Initializing mapfile caches
java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: com.google.common.cache.CacheBuilder.recordStats()Lcom/google/common/cache/CacheBuilder;
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.initializeCaches(PersonalServer.java:427)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:39)
at sun.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:25)
at java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:597)
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.startme(PersonalServer.java:720)
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.run(PersonalServer.java:760)
at org.apache.hadoop.util.ToolRunner.run(ToolRunner.java:70)
at org.godhuli.rhipe.PersonalServer.main(PersonalServer.java:772)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
at sun.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:39)
at sun.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:25)
at java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:597)
at org.apache.hadoop.util.RunJar.main(RunJar.java:208)

Error in Rhipe:::send.cmd(rhoptions()$child$handle, list("initializeCaches",  : 
  Error response from Rhipe Java server.

After seeing this, I installed guava-14.0-rc2.jar and pushed it onto CLASSPATH. However the error persists. 
I confirmed a hit for recordStats in CacheBuilder.class, included in the jarfile.

Any suggestions?

--
